name: Transport Data Set 5
definition: Provides details on the transportation of goods that are part of a commercial trade agreement.

DataSetIdentification.name: Data Set Identification
DataSetIdentification.definition: Identifies the submitted transport data set.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that buys goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that sells goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Consignor.name: Consignor
Consignor.definition: Party responsible for dispatching the goods.

Consignee.name: Consignee
Consignee.definition: Party to whom the goods must be delivered.

ShipTo.name: Ship To
ShipTo.definition: Party to whom the goods must be delivered in the end.

TransportInformation.name: Transport Information
TransportInformation.definition: Specifies the shipment date, the charges, the routing and the goods that are described in the transport document.
